description: Screening estimate for a solar project of a given size at a Texas point: expected energy (MWh per MW-ac per year) from NASA POWER monthly irradiance and temperature with stated assumptions (DC/AC 1.3, 14% losses, fixed tilt or single-axis tracking), the solar capture price at the nearest ERCOT resource node (node monthly day-ahead average over the last 12 complete months times the node's solar-hour price ratio from the last 90 days, weighted by ERCOT's system solar output shape), a system-wide curtailment haircut from ERCOT's solar report, and the resulting annual energy revenue. Day-ahead energy only: no real-time, RECs, PPA, basis to the project's own node, degradation or opex. A screening number, not a forecast. Use for 'how much would a solar farm here make', 'solar capture price near X', 'MWh per MW of solar in West Texas'. Free: MWh per MW-ac and a capture price band. Pro: the revenue, curtailment haircut and monthly table.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

curtailment_pct.description: Override the curtailment haircut, percent of energy (Pro). Default is ERCOT's trailing 12-month system-wide midday proxy.

dc_ac.description: DC to AC ratio, 1.0 to 1.6. Default 1.3.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

losses_pct.description: System losses excluding temperature and clipping, percent. Default 14.

months.description: Months of price history for the capture price (Pro), 6 to 36. Default 12; calendar months seen more than once are averaged.

mw_ac.description: Project size in MW-ac. Default 100, 1 to 2000.

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point (hub, zone or resource node) for pricing; the irradiance still needs an address or lat/lng, otherwise the node's own location is used.

name: solar_revenue_estimate
title: Screening energy revenue estimate for a solar project at an ERCOT node
